annotations.title: Preserve a page as evidence (capture link)

description: Get the link to Lawyerd's free evidence-capture form for a public web page the user wants preserved before it disappears. Read-only: this tool captures nothing and sends nothing — it returns the form link (https://lawyerd.net/evidence/) and what the capture package contains. The user starts the capture there with their own email after a quick human check (free: 3/day, 10/month per email); the package — full-page screenshot, raw and rendered HTML, HTTP headers, hosting/registrar context, SHA-256 hashes of every artifact, an OpenTimestamps anchor and an Internet Archive snapshot — is emailed to them. Use when the user wants to "save proof" or a "screenshot for court" of a scam or infringing page before a takedown. Public pages only (no logins/paywalls). Not notarization.
